attributes.description: Inventory of enrolled ChromeOS devices: status, OS compliance, boot mode, auto-update expiration and sync activity.

params.markdown:
The ChromeOS Devices dashboard shows the **inventory** of ChromeOS and ChromeOS Flex devices enrolled in Google Workspace, collected by the `chromeos_devices` data stream: one document per device per collection cycle. It describes what exists, not what happened; ChromeOS activity is in the Chrome dashboard.

Devices are collected once per interval (24 hours by default), so the dashboard opens on the last 24 hours. Counts are unique devices.

**Managed** devices are those with status `ACTIVE` or `DISABLED`. Deprovisioned devices stay in the inventory.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/google_workspace/)**
